address: Mandarin Oriental, Al Faisaliah Tower, King Fahd Road, Al Olaya, Riyadh, 11491, Saudi Arabia
bio: Inside the sphere atop the iconic Al Faisaliah Tower sits this modern restaurant, which has been a culinary landmark in Riyadh since 2000. The 360˚views of the cityscape, with the Kingdom Tower in the distance, are impressive. The friendly team deliver impeccable service for a truly exceptional experience. Here, the cooking is very much rooted in the classical repertoire but also comes with a modern touch and a nod to local produce. Some noteworthy dishes include hamour in a herb crust and white beans paired with a citrus beurre blanc or the more classical navarin-styled pressed lamb shoulder.
